Vendored dependency -- self-hosted per spec/architecture.md, Supply chain
(no third-party CDN sits inside the trust boundary).

Package:  @alpinejs/csp (the CSP-safe build -- no `unsafe-eval` needed for
          `x-` expressions; the plain Alpine build is never served here).
Version:  3.15.12
Source:   https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@alpinejs/csp@3.15.12/dist/cdn.min.js
SRI:      sha384-MKLWq9B+VC0W3U8kDIBEsSu8uCnQ1B0UQpRaB+F7uR5ocXFbymMUKuLRntu5LLdu

The hash above is held as ALPINE_SRI in solvent/shell.py, rendered into
the template's <script integrity="..."> attribute, and recomputed from
the file on disk in tests/test_chrome.py, so a tampered or re-fetched
file fails closed rather than silently serving different bytes than the
ones reviewed here.

Re-pin by re-downloading the new version's cdn.min.js, recomputing:
  openssl dgst -sha384 -binary cdn.min.js | openssl base64 -A
and updating both this file and ALPINE_SRI in solvent/shell.py.
Dependencies touching the auth/session path (this one, per
architecture.md, Supply chain) need manual review on any version bump,
never auto-merge.
